## Customer Feedback Analyzer
Hundreds of reviews in, a one-page 'what to fix first' report out.

Every Monday it reads collected reviews (source, rating, comment), scores sentiment with negation handling, tags themes (delivery, price, quality, staff, ordering) and sends a ranked 'fix first' report.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/customer-feedback-analyzer
